justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent correctly interpreted "in three days at 10h" as June 4th at 10 AM, and continued to understand the user's temporal preferences throughout the conversation.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent proposed reasonable alternatives on June 5th and 6th after the initial preferred time was unavailable, but it repeated the same list of options in turn 4 and 5.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeated its initial greeting and the same list of available slots multiple times, leading to unnecessary turns.
justifications.customer_experience: The experience was workable but tiring due to the agent repeating the same information and apology multiple times.
justifications.recovery_quality: The agent recovered well by offering alternative dates and times, but it did repeat the same set of alternatives when the user re-iterated their preference for June 4th.
